text: {"label":"Positive and Negative Reinforcement Concepts","definition":"Conceptual, basic, and applied work on the nature of reinforcement itself, including positive versus negative reinforcement, induction and molar accounts, reinforcement arrangements, and treating problem behavior maintained by escape or avoidance.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Addresses reinforcement as a general process and the positive–negative distinction, rather than alternative-behavior treatments and resurgence, response–reinforcer correlations and dependencies, or conditioned reinforcement in human choice."}
